title: BEYU OS Production Integrity, Continuity & Runtime Hardening

overallGate.reason: Source hardening was applied, but PostgreSQL, live RLS/pool/HTTP/fault-injection/recovery validation is unavailable and residual security gaps remain.

remediations.before: Session-level set_config(false) on a shared pool with no connection pinning or reset
remediations.after: One context-aware canonical db proxy routed by AsyncLocalStorage to one transaction; set_config(..., true) is cleared on commit/rollback

remediations.before: A surrounding request transaction could roll back a durable claim after context wrapping
remediations.after: Claim commits independently on the same canonical pool; handler domain work and completion share the request transaction; unexpected failure leaves IN_FLIGHT

remediations.before: Legacy hash omitted material audit metadata
remediations.after: New hash_version=2 records hash the complete audit envelope; null/1 historical rows use legacy verification without rewrite

remediations.before: Counter increment was based on a stale pre-read user row
remediations.after: Current user row is locked and incremented inside a transaction

remediations.before: First X-Forwarded-For value was always trusted
remediations.after: Forwarded IP is used only when BEYU_TRUST_PROXY=true; otherwise the control fails closed to an unknown bucket

build.detail: Compilation and page generation only; database connectivity not proven

fullTestSuite.reason: DATABASE_URL is required at src/db/index.ts:7; PostgreSQL unavailable

zeroSkipped.detail: HTTP suites remained unavailable/skip-gated; no skipped suite was counted as PASS

npmAuditOmitDev.detail: Next/PostCSS direct patch versions applied; remaining findings include transitive sharp/PostCSS and dev-only Vitest/Vite paths
